prompt: What is the name of the Australian novelist who is one of only five writers to have won the Booker Prize twice and also won the Jerusalem Prize?
answer: The Australian novelist is **J. M. Coetzee** (John Maxwell Coetzee). South African-born and an Australian citizen since 2006, he won the Booker Prize for *Life & Times of Michael K* (1983) and *Disgrace* (1999), and the Jerusalem Prize in 1987.
